judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a definition-of-done document (`.lore/dod.md`) and two test files (`registry.acceptance.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts`), without actually implementing any of the production changes in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` or adding `ajv` to `package.json`. Consequently, all the newly added validation tests will fail against the unedited `ToolRegistry`. Furthermore, the test file names do not match the ticket's explicit criteria (`registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`), and several tests have flaws (such as `compiles static schema once` asserting on an unused local `compilationCount = 0` variable, and `chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` expecting `result.entries` when `processMessage` returns a string). Finally, none of the required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`) or spec links required by `re-lint/require-spec-link` were created.
